description: Minimal Quartz.NET project with IJob consumers, [DisallowConcurrentExecution], JobBuilder.Create producers, TriggerBuilder, and scheduler.ScheduleJob. Used by the extraction-quality benchmark to verify PRODUCES/CONSUMES edge emission for Quartz.NET.

expected_relationships.note: #6490 arm B. `class Startup { Task ConfigureScheduler(IScheduler scheduler) }`.
Second class in the same file — the CONTAINS must not be hoisted onto ReportJob.
The job-class view of the same declaration, emitted by the Quartz.NET framework pass.
`var reportJob = JobBuilder.Create<ReportJob>()...Build();` — the generic type argument names the job class being built.
`var trigger = TriggerBuilder.Create()...Build();` — external Quartz.NET API, so a bare-name target is the correct shape.
`await scheduler.ScheduleJob(reportJob, trigger);` resolved through the declared parameter type IScheduler.

#6741 arm 3. `JobBuilder.Create<ReportJob>()` in Startup.cs dispatches the IJob declared in jobs/ReportJob.cs. ADR-0028 §1's one-hop degenerate form: producer -> job class, carrying `task:quartz.net:ReportJob` as a property. Cross-file, so the edge targets the resolvable `Class:ReportJob` stub the C# passes already use for out-of-file types.
The second builder must pair with the type IT names, not with whichever job class happens to come first.

#6490 arm B FINDING: the fixture asserts a `scheduler.ScheduleJob` schedule_job ENTITY (and it is extracted), but nothing points at it — the CALLS from the enclosing method goes to the bare name `IScheduler.ScheduleJob` instead. The schedule_job entity is a graph orphan.

#6490 arm B FINDING: `public class ReportJob : IJob` emits no IMPLEMENTS edge. Java's equivalent (java-quartz-mini's SendEmailJob implements Job) DOES emit one, so this is a C#-specific hierarchy gap, not a framework one.

#6490 arm B FINDING: `scheduler.ScheduleJob(reportJob, trigger)` registers ReportJob with the scheduler, and no edge of any kind connects the two. The graph contains zero PRODUCES/CONSUMES/TRIGGERS edges despite this fixture's description naming PRODUCES/CONSUMES as its purpose — contrast java-quartz-mini, which does emit a TRIGGERS edge for the same pattern in Java.

#6490 arm B FINDING: the `report-trigger` entity is extracted with no edges at all. `TriggerBuilder.Create().WithIdentity("report-trigger")` is passed to ScheduleJob alongside reportJob; the trigger→job association is in the source and absent from the graph.
